measurement_semantics.pdr_at_app_stop: packets received no later than application stop divided by generated packets
measurement_semantics.pdr_at_sim_end: packets received by app stop plus drain divided by generated packets
measurement_semantics.app_stop_delivery_mbps: bytes received by app stop normalized to the 5-second offered interval
measurement_semantics.final_delivery_offered_interval_mbps: all bytes received by simulation end normalized to the 5-second offered interval
measurement_semantics.receive_window_goodput_mbps: all bytes received by simulation end normalized to 5 seconds plus drain
measurement_semantics.application_undelivered_backlog: generated application packets not observed at the sink by simulation end; not a direct MAC queue measurement

trace_equivalence_scope: mapping, packet events, scheduler decisions, and PHY records; run_id excluded
